personality_one_liner: A highly professional, premium, and trustworthy Indian service platform combining sleek iOS-native layouts with a stark, high-contrast operational palette.

spacing.rule: Maintain iOS-native generous padding. Group related elements cleanly. Sticky CTAs at the bottom for bookings. Avoid clutter.

do's: Use frosted glass on sticky headers, bottom tab bar, bottom sheets, and hero cards.
Overlay glass on map interfaces to maintain context.
dont's: Avoid on form inputs, standard list rows, and ERP data tables.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Allow users to quickly find a trusted driver and select a service type.

states.empty: No services available in this location
states.error: Unable to load services, Retry button

screens.layout: Hero card at the top ('Find a Trusted Driver...') overlaid on the abstract background with gradient scrim. Below hero, a multi-column grid of Service Categories (Hourly, Full-Day, Night, Outstation, etc.) in tinted cards. Bottom sheet or sticky button for quick booking.

screens.name: Booking Wizard
screens.purpose: Capture trip details, provide fare estimate, and take Razorpay advance.
screens.layout: Location inputs at the top. Map in the center displaying route. Bottom sheet slides up displaying fare estimate (using Space Grotesk for numbers). Sticky 'Pay 20% Advance to Confirm' primary red CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Driver Dashboard & Trip Workflow
screens.purpose: Provide the driver with their current operational status and trip progression.

states.empty: No active trips right now. Go online to receive jobs.

screens.layout: Top sticky header with a massive 'Online/Offline' toggle. Main area uses chronological timeline cards (Depart -> Arrive -> OTP -> Start Trip -> Complete). High-contrast typography, large tap targets for driving safety. Job offers appear as high-priority bottom sheets.

screens.name: ERP / Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide operations overview, KPIs, and dispatch management.

states.empty: No data for this time period

screens.layout: Clean, high-density cards using surfaceSecondary. Grid of KPI summary cards at the top (Revenue, Active Drivers). Below, tabbed view for Tables (Dispatch, P&L, Support Tickets) with clear filtering options. No unnecessary animations.

hero_background.alt: abstract white background with vertical lines

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the user's provided color palette: Deep black (#171717), Charcoal (#292929), Mid-grey (#6B7280), Light-grey (#F3F4F6), White (#FFFFFF), and Brand red (#E53935).
Light theme only as explicitly requested. Do not implement a dark mode switch.
Typography: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for the primary text to enforce a premium, trustworthy look. Use Space Grotesk selectively for numerical data like fare estimates, P&L numbers, and OTP inputs.
For the Driver interface, prioritize high-contrast, large tap targets, and simple chronological timeline layouts over map aesthetics, as safety and clarity are paramount.
Use image_generation_tool to generate illustrative imagery for empty states (e.g., minimalist vector of a steering wheel or road) as the user explicitly instructed NOT to use real employee photos.
Ensure sticky CTAs are anchored at the bottom (e.g., 'Pay 20% Advance') with a subtle top shadow or glassmorphism effect.
Build the ERP/Admin screens with clean, structured tables and KPI cards. Optimize for scanning without clutter or unnecessary animations.
Implement the 3 distinct roles (Customer, Driver, Admin) with role-based navigation loops that use the same underlying design system.
